source = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if marker_rows:
        marker = marker_rows[0]
        marker_color = grid[marker][0]
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != marker_color]
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        thickness = hi - lo + 1
        direction = 1 if (lo + hi) / 2 > marker else -1
        target = marker + direction * (thickness + 1)
        for c in range(w): out[target][c] = 8
        center = (h - 1) / 2
        obj_center = (lo + hi) / 2
        if (marker - center) * (obj_center - center) < 0 and abs(obj_center - center) > 2 * thickness:
            new_lo = marker + direction
            delta = new_lo - lo
            for r, c in cells: out[r][c] = background
            for r, c in cells: out[r + delta][c] = grid[r][c]
    else:
        marker = marker_cols[0]
        marker_color = grid[0][marker]
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != marker_color]
        lo, hi = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        thickness = hi - lo + 1
        direction = 1 if (lo + hi) / 2 > marker else -1
        target = marker + direction * (thickness + 1)
        for r in range(h): out[r][target] = 8
        center = (w - 1) / 2
        obj_center = (lo + hi) / 2
        if (marker - center) * (obj_center - center) < 0 and abs(obj_center - center) > 2 * thickness:
            new_lo = marker + direction
            delta = new_lo - lo
            for r, c in cells: out[r][c] = background
            for r, c in cells: out[r][c + delta] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
